clem.failure_summary: The six-feature baseline has insufficient representation breadth.
supporting_evidence: EXP_000 contains the frozen six-feature bootstrap baseline.
why_not_other_layers: The mandatory alpha bootstrap precedes model and portfolio adaptation.
clem.intervention_goal: Expand the feature representation from six to ten factors.

specialist.local_diagnosis: The anchors emphasize contemporaneous price ratios and one-day lags but lack medium-horizon momentum, smoothing, dispersion, and price-volume interaction.
specialist.reasoning: The Agent selected four complementary Alpha158 factors after comparing complete train-only evidence. This is an illustrative choice, not a frozen rule or recommended winning subset.
specialist.falsification_condition: The broader representation is falsified if validation Sharpe worsens materially or its declared mechanism moves opposite.
